Listen to this...!

got a lot of positive feedback...

Man, I just can't stop vanity searching...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hearing what people think make me reeeeeeally happy, you know!

text_block_list.text:
Fuhehe...♪ Whoops.
I gotta hurry, homeroom is gonna...!

It seems Kiseki stayed up late reading reviews of her manga.
She looks happy, but it seems she didn't get enough rest...
